gizmo.title: Amanothi omculo
gizmo.description: Ibonisa futhi idlale amanothi omculo, amathebhu esiginci, nokubhalwa kwamaphuzu ngo-alphaTex noma i-MusicXML.

configure.title: Ukubhalwa kwe-AlphaTex
configure.description: Umaka we-alphaTex ophakathi nombhalo wamanothi omculo. Hlela ngqo ukuze ubhale amanothi; kugcinwa kuthempulethi ukuze izikhala zigcinwe.

configure.title: Ifayela lamaphuzu
configure.description: Layisha noma uxhumanise nefayela le-MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) noma le-Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Lidlula i-alphaTex ephakathi nombhalo uma lisethiwe.

advanced.title: Ukudlala umsindo
advanced.description: Kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo - lalela amanothi omculo edlalwa ngesisinthesayiza esakhelwe ngaphakathi. Vala ukuze kube imodi yokubuka kuphela (ngaphandle komsindo).

advanced.title: Bonisa izinketho zokubonisa
advanced.description: Bonisa izinkinobho zokusondeza, zokwelula, nezesakhiwo ebheni lesidlali.

advanced.title: Bonisa izinkinobho zokuthumela
advanced.description: Bonisa izinkinobho zokulanda i-MIDI nezokuphrinta/i-PDF ebheni lesidlali.
